title: Voice and tone
slide_intent: Define a tone by giving each quality a boundary. Paired descriptions help a writer recognize when confidence, humor or helpfulness becomes excessive.
strategic_value: Slack can retain a recognizable personality while allowing the substance of a message to lead.
demonstration: The left column lists seven traits and qualifies several with a contrasting limit. Explanatory paragraphs at right discuss clarity, word choice and how much personality a message needs.
practical_value: Use one pair of traits to edit a draft, such as keeping the confidence while removing a boast.
